trailheadDirection: From Newhalem, drive SR-20 east about 14 miles; the trailhead parking is on the right between mileposts 134 and 135.
approach: From the Ross Dam Trailhead (SR-20 milepost 134), cross Ross Dam and work around the lake to the Big Beaver Trail, or save about 7 miles by taking the lake boat shuttle to Big Beaver landing. Follow Big Beaver Trail past Luna Camp, roughly 10 miles up from the landing, and leave it about 1.5 miles beyond the camp at a big cairn on the left. Drop through forest to Big Beaver Creek, ford it since logs are not dependable, then traverse southwest through alder thickets to the head of Access Creek, crossing it near 3900 ft and camping in the meadow near 4200 ft. From there climb about 2000 ft of loose gully to the col that opens onto the southwest ridge, and make an ascending traverse to the next col at the edge of the ridge, where the climbing starts.
note: one trip report climbing the SW Ridge via Big Beaver/Access Creek; Ross Dam start from a second page; pages cached
